{{Quote|I haven't had this much fun since my Space Ranger days!|Zell, after defeating the pirate [[Reddjak]]|<ref name="Droids (1986) 3">[[Droids (1986) 3|''Droids'' (1986) 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Republic Space Rangers''' were a body of armed beings affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were notably trained in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]]. [[Zell]], who became the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of [[Majoor]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was a former elite Space Ranger.
